title: Study of IBI3020 Treatment in Participants With Late-Stage Solid Tumors
official: A Phase 1, Multicenter, Open-label Study of IBI3020 Treatment in Participants With Unresectable, Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of IBI3020 and to determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and/or the recommended dose for expansion (RP2D) of IBI3020.
